name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), the closest bar to LAX, since 1952.
Free parking, including a free lot for people picking up travelers.
About a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals, 5 minutes by car.
Hours on Melody's website: Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM, Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Late-night hours can vary, so call to confirm.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM every day.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Melody Rewards is free to join. You get 100 points when you join.
Earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip).
Until the register connection goes live, tap 'Add my visit' and snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday).
One receipt per member per day, each check counts once, up to $150 per check.
Rewards: 250 pts free soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off your check, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entree.
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year.
Referral: +100 points for each friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Nearby alerts bonus: +100 points once, if location and notifications were on for 3 different days over at least 7 days.
Game points: up to 50 a day from the games. There is no spin, wheel or lucky draw.
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking. A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens.
Rewards have no cash value, can't be transferred, and are never free alcohol.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with a Campaign mode (10 levels) and a Survival mode.
The weekly boards reset every Monday. Weekly prizes are in BETA and not on yet, so boards are for bragging rights for now.
When game rewards turn on: 1 point per 100 score, and the top player on each board may win the weekly prize (for example, free Melody Fries).
Melody Games: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare and the LA Scoreboard.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Order from your phone: pick the bar, patio, to go, or scan your table code. Pay your server or bartender like normal.
The app has 12 languages.
No download needed. It opens in your phone's browser and can be added to your Home Screen.
Melody Rewards points are separate from Nalu Vida points (Melody's sister spot at Venice Pier).
LAX crew (airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car, shuttle workers) get 10% off the check with a badge, dine-in only.

qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester. Tap Directions in the app to get there.
You can call us at (310) 670-1994, or tap the Call button in the app.
Melody's website lists Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Late-night hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
I can't see live open status. Hours are Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM, but they can vary late at night. Call (310) 670-1994 to be sure.
I don't have a kitchen closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Yes. Parking is free, and there's a free lot for people picking up travelers.
Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is also about 5 minutes away by car.
Yes, we're the closest bar to LAX, at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd in Westchester.
I don't have reservation details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask.
Yes, there's a patio. In the app you can pick Patio when you order.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM every day.

qa.q: What are the happy hour prices?
qa.a: The app shows happy hour as 3-6 daily but doesn't list the prices. Tuesdays have $6 margaritas. Ask your server for today's happy hour menu.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.
Monday is half off burgers, 11 AM to 3 PM.
Tuesday is Taco Tuesday: every taco is $4, plus $6 margaritas.
The app doesn't list a Wednesday food special. Karaoke is a weekly event, and I don't have the details, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Thursday is half off sandwiches, 11 AM to 3 PM.
Friday is $3 sliders, 11 AM to 3 PM.
Weekend hours start at 9 AM. The app doesn't list weekend food specials, but happy hour is 3-6 every day. Ask staff about weekend events.
Yes. Karaoke, live bands, DJs and trivia run every week. I don't have the exact night and time in the app, so call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have live music or DJs?
qa.a: Yes, there are live bands and DJs every week. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 for who's playing and when.
Trivia is listed as a weekly event. I don't have the night or time, so please ask staff. You can also play trivia in the app anytime.

qa.q: Can I watch the game here?
qa.a: Yes. Every game is on the TVs. The app also has a live LA Scoreboard with Where to watch info.
I don't have cover charge info for every event. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have a dress code. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have an age policy for evenings. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994, especially for after-dark visits.
I don't have a pet policy. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you do private events or catering?
qa.a: I don't have private event or catering details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have delivery info in the app. You can pick To go when you order, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have a LAX crew discount?
qa.a: Yes. Airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers get 10% off the check with a badge or proof of work. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap the Melody Rewards section in the app and join. It's free and takes about 10 seconds, and you get your gold card on your phone.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download. Open it in your phone's browser from the table QR code or @melodylax on Instagram, and add it to your Home Screen if you like.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I earn points on my check?
qa.a: Tap 'Add my visit' in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once the register connection is live this will be automatic.

qa.q: Are there limits on adding my visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check counts once, and up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. You still earn points on every check, whether you order in the app or with your server.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 bonus points once when you join.
+100 once when you join, +250 once a year on your birthday, +100 per friend who joins with your code and visits, and up to +50 a day from games. There's also a one-time +100 nearby alerts bonus.

250 points: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500: $10 off your check. 1,000: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500: free entree. Your rewards card shows your current options.
At 1,500 points you can get a free entree up to $21.50: a Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap 'Use reward' and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does my reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Each visit gets a fresh one-time code.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward per visit?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, and rewards can't be stacked. A second prize the same day shows 'Come back tomorrow'.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol as a reward?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.
I don't have expiry details. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff if you have questions.

qa.q: Can I swap rewards for cash or give them to someone?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.
I don't have any membership levels or tiers listed in the app. Ask staff for details.
Yes. You get +250 points once a year on your birthday as a Melody Rewards member.
Share your code. When a friend joins with it and makes a first visit, you get +100 points. Each member can enter one friend's code when joining, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Can I change my referral code later?
qa.a: No. It's entered once when you join and can't be changed or swapped.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird or founding-member gift?
qa.a: The rules mention an early-bird or founding-member gift, but I don't have the details. Ask staff.

qa.q: What is the nearby alerts bonus?
qa.a: Turn on nearby alerts in the app and you'll see a 'You're nearby' deal when you open the app within about half a mile of Melody. If location and notifications are on for 3 different days over at least 7 days, you get a one-time +100 points.

qa.q: Can I turn off nearby alerts?
qa.a: Yes. Tap 'Turn off nearby alerts' in the app and/or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you already earned stay.
If you landed at LAX in the last 24 hours, show your boarding pass to your server for 10% off your first order today. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Do I get a rewards card on my phone?
qa.a: Yes. The My Rewards Card in the app shows your card ID, points, next reward and QR code. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't turned on yet.
It's a free arcade flying game. Fly a night dogfight over LA in Campaign mode (10 levels) or last as long as you can in Survival mode.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the boost button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

Campaign is 10 levels of about 45 seconds each, following a SoCal route from Melody over Inglewood, the 105 to LAX, Venice Pier, Compton, Long Beach and Hollywood. It has six boss fights, then you land back at LAX.
Survival has no finish line and keeps getting harder until your plane goes down. Your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How does scoring and health work?
qa.a: You shoot down enemies and bosses, dodge their fire (every attack is warned first), and catch Melody's food and music notes. Three hits and your plane goes down.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses, or flying longer in Survival, unlocks stronger guns. They use limited ammo that you refill by catching ammo crates.
Yes. Tap the crossed-swords button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: How often can I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free, with or without an account, and no purchase is necessary.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two boards: Campaign (ranked by score) and Survival (ranked by longest time). Tap 'Post my score' after a flight to get on the board. Both reset every Monday, and practice flights don't count.

Prizes are in BETA and switched off for now, so the boards are for bragging rights. When they turn on, the top player on each board may win the weekly prize shown in the game, for example free Melody Fries.

qa.q: How do I pick up my weekly prize?
qa.a: Weekly prizes aren't on yet, and I don't have pickup details. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do I earn points from Melody Approach?
qa.a: Not yet. Game rewards are off during the BETA. When they turn on you'll earn 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: What games are in Melody Games?
qa.a: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare, the daily Melody Word and Melody Mix. You can play solo or pass the phone around the table.
Pick a category, then answer 10 questions against the clock. Faster right answers score more. You can play solo or pass the phone with 2-6 players.
Pick your team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a Fan Rating, or play mixed LA sports questions. It's a timed quiz and you can pass the phone around the table.
It's a daily 5-letter word game, the same word for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.
It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out, with 3 skips.
It's a fun table game for 1-6 players, with light truths and table dares. Dares never involve drinking, and anyone can pass. No points are given.

qa.q: Do the quick games earn points?
qa.a: Not during the BETA. When game rewards turn on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and Melody Word 3 points (fewer with hints). The cap is 10 Games Pack points a day.
It shows live scores for LA and California teams (from ESPN, for information only, no streams), plus where to watch. You can follow your teams and check details.
They're free, just-for-fun picks with no money or wagers. Once game rewards are on, a right pick made before the game starts earns 2 points, up to 6 a day. Picks lock when the game starts.

It's a free-to-enter game per NFL or college game. Every member can get one free square by tapping 'Get my free square', and staff can add extra squares with a purchase. Numbers are drawn at kickoff and winners are picked at the end of each quarter and the final.

qa.q: What can I win in Football Squares?
qa.a: Prizes are shown on each board before you play. They can be food, merch, % off the check, a free non-alcoholic drink, or % off a drink (21+ with ID). No cash or gift cards, and never free alcohol. Claim at Melody with your Rewards card.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Scan your table's QR code and your table is already picked. Or choose Bar, Patio or To go. Add items, tap Review order, then Send my order.
To the spot you pick: your table, the bar, the patio or to go. To-go orders get a text when they're ready.
Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app doesn't take payment, and you still earn points on every check.
Starters (like Lemon Pepper Wings and Baby Back Ribs & Fries), Mac & Cheese, the Melody Burger, fries, soups, and tacos and burritos, plus drinks. Browse them in the Menu tab.

Lemon Pepper Wings $16, Avocado Toast $13, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites $15, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries $16, Chicken Pot Stickers $15, Fried Green Beans $13, Fried Shrimp $18.25, Jalapeno Calamari $16, Lettuce Wraps $16 and Baby Back Ribs & Fries $20.25.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: Lobster $21.50, Melody Burger Mac $19.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25 and House Mac $15.
The app shows the Melody Burger, $19.25: Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries.

qa.q: What fries and sides do you have?
qa.a: Melody Fries $5.75, Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Sweet Potato Fries $7.75, Onion Strings $9.75 and Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25. Add cheese for $2 on Melody and Phat Fries.
French Onion, Tomato Bisque (cup $11, bowl $15) and Black Bean (cup $9.75, bowl $14).

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos come 2 per order: Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Beyond $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13. Burritos: Carnitas $18.25, Steak $18.25, Chicken $17.25, Bean & Cheese $14. Also Nachos $15 and Cheese Quesadilla $15.

qa.q: Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app shows Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, Bean & Cheese Burrito, Avocado Toast, Fried Green Beans, House Mac and Cheese Quesadilla. Check ingredients with staff for any dietary needs.
Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, shots and a Bucket of Beers (5). Tap a drink to see it poured.

Shown in the app: margaritas $12, Paloma $12, Old Fashioned $14, Moscow Mule $13, Espresso Martini $15, Long Island $14, Michelada $10, draft beer $8, Mimosa $10, shots $10 each, beer bucket $30. Drink prices are previews, so check with your server.
The app shows seasonal specials: Spooky Mac Night (Oct 20-31), Harvest Soup & Bites (Nov 20-28), Holiday Lobster Mac (Dec 15-25) and Countdown Wings (Dec 29-Jan 1).

qa.q: Can I see real photos of the food?
qa.a: Yes. Some menu items have a Real Photo or slow-mo tag, and some dishes have a Spin in 3D button. Tap them to see more.

qa.q: What languages does the app have?
qa.a: The app comes in 12 languages.
The app has a kid mode that hides adult-only games. I don't have details beyond that, so ask staff.
It's Melody's sister spot at Venice Pier. It has its own rewards balance, so Melody and Nalu Vida points don't move between the two.

Only if you turn on nearby alerts, and only while the app is open on your screen. Your exact location stays on your phone, and the app never tracks you in the background. It's never sold or shared, and not used for ads.

qa.q: What does the app record when I open it?
qa.a: At most once every 10 minutes it records the time, a short device summary, a random ID for your phone, and your member ID if you joined. If location is already on, it records one approximate spot (about 1 km). It's used for rewards limits, fraud prevention and visit stats, and is never sold.

qa.q: Do I have to join to play the games?
qa.a: No. The games are free to play with or without an account, and no purchase is necessary. Join to save any points.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What if I have a problem with my points?
qa.a: Show your server or bartender your rewards card, or call (310) 670-1994.
